patthana23.5:1.1: Nakusalaṃ nasavitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā nava.
patthana23.5:2.1: Nakusalaṃ naavitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā nava.
patthana23.5:3.1: Nakusalaṃ naavitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā dvādasa.
